Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 39

“The one who has faith obtains knowledge — intent upon it, with the senses restrained. Having obtained knowledge, one quickly attains supreme peace.”

Faith first, then knowledge, then peace. Krishna orders them carefully: shraddha is not the reward for understanding but the condition that makes understanding possible, which reverses the sequence most people would assume.
